inShort: B feeds dinks that sit up, and A speeds up to one target per round: shoulder, hip, across the body, off-pace, slider. Then swap.
rules: A and B stand at the kitchen line, straight across. B feeds dinks that sit up enough to attack.
Round 1: speed up at B's paddle-side shoulder. Round 2: at B's paddle-side hip.
Round 3: from A's forehand side, go across B's body to the other side. Round 4: speed-ups that are clearly slower than full pace.
Round 5: B slides a step to one side just before A hits. A aims a step outside the spot B slides to.
8–10 balls per round. B blocks softly or lets the ball go, then feeds the next dink.
tooEasy: A mixes the five targets without saying which, and B tries to block it back. Even harder: 8 of 10 hit the chosen spot.
tooHard: A calls the target out loud before each ball, and B feeds the same dink every time.
goodLooksLike: The ball hits the chosen spot, and B's block pops up or misses.
